method: hand-computed synthetic fixtures; expected numbers written literally in the test, never derived from production code; production modules NOT modified; invariant 8 encoded as a test-local single-writer guard (production ledgers carry no locking primitive)

invariants.invariant: CASH is not a symbol (never in symbols, weights, turnover or held-position/concentration paths)
invariants.hand_computed_expected: turnover(before {AAA:0.5,CASH:0.5} -> after {AAA:0.25,CASH:0.25,BBB:0.5}) = |0.25-0.5|+|0.5-0| = 0.75 (naive CASH-inclusive would be 1.00); normalize_entry_targets -> symbols {AAA,BBB}, cash 0.25; A5-book symbol_contribution keys == {AAA}; all-cash book n_held_positions = 0; drop-one refuses CASH
invariants.observed: 0.75; {AAA,BBB}/0.25; {AAA}; 0; ValueError 'CASH is not a tradable leg'

invariants.invariant: Cost charged exactly once per fill (no sidecar double-charge)
invariants.hand_computed_expected: factory path: cost = 1.0*1.0*100/1e4 = 0.01 charged once -> equity 0.99/1.089/1.1979, total_cost 0.01, fill_costs [(D1,1.0,0.01)], residual 0 (double-charge signature 0.98 absent). Ledger path: cash = 1000-2*10-2 = 978.0 exactly; equity at fill 998.0 = 1000-2.0; cost buckets 1.0/0.5/0.25/0.25 sum 2.0 (each single); terminal mark 11 -> equity 1000.0, terminal_pnl 2.0, residual exactly 0
invariants.observed: 0.99/1.089/1.1979 (rel 1e-12); total_cost == 0.01; 978.0; 998.0; buckets 1.0/0.5/0.25/0.25; 1000.0; residual 0.0; assert_reconciles and assert_closed both pass

invariants.invariant: Turnover convention: ONE named convention, sum(|delta weight|) over tradable (non-CASH) legs
invariants.hand_computed_expected: before {AAA:0.5,BBB:0.25,CASH:0.25} -> after {AAA:0.25,BBB:0.5}: 0.25+0.25 = 0.50; unchanged book = 0.0; liquidation {AAA:1.0}->{CASH:1.0} = 1.0 (ETF leg charged once, not 2.0); convention owned by the single named function etf_leg_turnover keyed on CASH_SYMBOL=='CASH'

invariants.invariant: Canonical artifact digest hashes exact artifact bytes (sorted keys, compact separators)
invariants.hand_computed_expected: canonical_json({b:2,a:1}) == '{"a":1,"b":2}'; sha256 of those exact bytes = 43258cff783fe7036d8a43033f830adfc60ec037382473548ac742b888292777 (precomputed independently); bytes on disk hash identically; changing a:1->a:2 gives 4c7aa83d...; wrapper {artifact:...} hashes 2908614c... and must NOT equal the artifact digest
invariants.observed: ledger-recorded artifact_digest == 43258cff...; sha256_file(canonical bytes on disk) == 43258cff...; changed-value digest == 4c7aa83d... != artifact digest; wrapper digest == 2908614c... != 43258cff...

invariants.invariant: Append-only correction does not alter counters
invariants.hand_computed_expected: after 1 compute + 1 publish: observed=1, published=1, entries=3; appending 2 correction/repin entries leaves observed=1, published=1, published_keys intact, original 3 entries unchanged as a prefix, total entries 5; save/reload round-trip keeps (1,1,5)
invariants.observed: observed=1, published=1 before and after; prefix equal; 5 entries; reloaded ledger observed=1, published=1, entries=5

invariants.invariant: Observed increments once when a score exists; replays increment neither counter
invariants.hand_computed_expected: compute_recorded once -> observed=1; first publish_result -> True, published=1, observed stays 1; two identical replays -> False, False; observed stays 1, published stays 1; exactly 2 REPLAY_ZERO_DELTA events appended
invariants.observed: True; observed=1/published=1 after both replays; 2 REPLAY_ZERO_DELTA events

invariants.invariant: Zero-position and out-of-contract cells are refused
invariants.hand_computed_expected: n_held_positions=0 -> refused with reasons [ZERO_HELD_POSITIONS], key unpublished, observed keeps its single increment (=1), refusal recorded append-only; n_fill_events=0 -> [ZERO_FILL_EVENTS]; non-int counts raise ValueError; out-of-contract cell (wrong arm id ARM_EVIL, wrong universe U2, held security not an effective member, membership before effective_from) all raise CellContractError; production replay refuses unknown/duplicate arms
invariants.observed: both refusals with exact reason lists, keys unpublished, observed=1; all five out-of-contract variants raised as expected

invariants.hand_computed_expected: two in-process emulations on one ledger guard can never share a serial slot: W1 claims slot 1, W2 must get slot 2 (never 1), a writer re-claiming is refused (None); two threads released by one barrier claim exactly the distinct slot set {1,2}
invariants.observed: W1->1, W2->2, W1 re-claim -> None, holders {W1:1, W2:2}; concurrent threads claimed exactly {1,2}, pairwise distinct, no errors
invariants.note: production TrialLedger/GatedTrialLedger have no locking primitive; the frozen A1 single-writer contract is encoded and proven by the test-local _SerialSlotLedger guard (flock + atomic state replace), per the regression/contract-proof mandate
